about: Permanent zones that reset like a Diablo zone (H4 item 10, the owner 3 Nov: 'a permanent one that can get reset like any diablo type zone'). Each zone's state (WorldState.Zone(id): packs down, chests opened) is cleared when its rule says, read by logic/World/ZoneReset.cs. reset: 'day' clears it on the day change (WorldState.Day); 'never' keeps it. keep: key prefixes in the zone's state never cleared. What is not zone state (a world fact such as a relit lamp-post, lampposts.<id>) is never touched.
